fixes.explanation: Matthew doesn't say the crowds were offended. He says, “When the crowds heard this, they were astonished at His teaching.” (Matthew 22:33). Seven brothers and a tangled question, and Jesus tells the Sadducees they don't know the Scriptures or the power of God. Then He points to God's own words: “He is not the God of the dead, but of the living.” That's the teaching that left the crowds amazed.
